title: Rectangular prism
spec: Create a new coordinate system with Euler angles set to zero degrees and a translation vector of [0.0469, 0.0, 0.0]. Next, draw a two-dimensional sketch on the first face. Begin with the first loop, starting with the first arc from the point [0.0, 0.0078] to [0.0023, 0.0023] and ending at [0.0077, 0.0]. Follow this with the first line from [0.0077, 0.0] to [0.0391, 0.0]. Continue with the second arc from [0.0391, 0.0] to [0.0446, 0.0023] and ending at [0.0469, 0.0078]. Draw the second line from [0.0469, 0.0078] to [0.0469, 0.086]. Add the third arc from [0.0469, 0.086] to [0.0446, 0.0915] and ending at [0.0391, 0.0938]. Draw the third line from [0.0391, 0.0938] to [0.0077, 0.0938]. Complete the loop with the fourth arc from [0.0077, 0.0938] to [0.0023, 0.0915] and ending at [0.0, 0.086], followed by the fourth line from [0.0, 0.086] to [0.0, 0.0078]. Scale the entire two-dimensional sketch by a factor of 0.0938. Transform the scaled sketch into three dimensions using the same Euler angles and translation vector. Extrude the sketch 0.75 units along the normal direction to create the three-dimensional model. Ensure that the extrusion does not occur in the opposite direction. This process will result in a rectangular prism with rounded corners, with a length of 0.04687500000000001, a width of 0.09375000000000001, and a height of 0.7500000000000001.

import cadquery as cq

# Define the sketch
sketch = cq.Workplane("XY").workplane()

# Create the arcs and lines
sketch = sketch.moveTo(0.0, 0.0078).threePointArc((0.0023, 0.0023), (0.0077, 0.0))
sketch = sketch.lineTo(0.0391, 0.0)
sketch = sketch.threePointArc((0.0446, 0.0023), (0.0469, 0.0078))
sketch = sketch.lineTo(0.0469, 0.086)
sketch = sketch.threePointArc((0.0446, 0.0915), (0.0391, 0.0938))
sketch = sketch.lineTo(0.0077, 0.0938)
sketch = sketch.threePointArc((0.0023, 0.0915), (0.0, 0.086))
sketch = sketch.lineTo(0.0, 0.0078)

# Close the sketch
sketch = sketch.close()

# Extrude the sketch
extrusion_depth = 0.75
r = sketch.extrude(extrusion_depth)

# Translate the model
r = r.translate((0.0469, 0.0, 0.0))

import cadquery as cq

X = 0.0469
Y = 0.0938
Z = 0.7500
corner_r = 0.0078

r = (
    cq.Workplane("XY")
    .rect(X, Y, centered=False)
    .extrude(Z)
    .edges("|Z")
    .fillet(corner_r)
)
